name: scroll-animation-text
title: Scroll Reveal Text
blurb: Text sections revealing from different directions as you scroll.
description: A section component displaying three text blocks animating in from different directions on scroll—left, right, and down. Uses ScrollAnimation for directional reveals.
use_when: A story or narrative section where directional text animation adds visual flow and guides the eye.
avoid_when: When you need to customize text content or animation timing at runtime — this is a fixed demo layout.
a11y: Text content is accessible via screen readers. Scroll animation cannot be controlled via keyboard.
